title: Update README to cover Phase 1 and Phase 2

author: Mourad-Fikry

title: Implement build_knowledge_base.py orchestrator
body:
Implements build_knowledge_base.py — the Phase 2 orchestrator.

Runs all four processors (process_commits, process_issues, process_pull_requests, process_docs), combines their output into a single list, and saves it to data/processed/knowledge_base.json.

This is the final Phase 2 deliverable: a unified knowledge base ready for embedding generation in Phase 3.
author: Mourad-Fikry

title: Implement process_docs.py
body:
Implements process_docs.py — reads data/docs.json and converts each markdown file into a human-readable text document ready for embedding.

Each document includes:
- id (based on filename)
- text (file path + content, truncated to 1000 chars for the embedding-ready version)
- metadata (filename, path, full untruncated content)
author: Mourad-Fikry

title: Implement process_pull_requests.py
body:
Implements process_pull_requests.py — reads data/pull_requests.json and converts each PR into a human-readable text document ready for embedding.

Each document includes:
- id (PR number)
- text (readable summary: title, author, status, files changed, linked issues)
- metadata (number, author, state, merged, created_at, files_changed, linked_issues)
author: Mourad-Fikry

title: Implement process_issues.py
body:
Implements process_issues.py — reads data/issues.json and converts each issue into a human-readable text document ready for embedding.

Each document includes:
- id (issue number)
- text (readable summary: title, author, state, date, labels, comment count)
- metadata (number, author, state, created_at, labels)

Note: returns an empty list currently since the repo has no issues yet — verified working correctly with no errors.
author: Mourad-Fikry

title: Implement process_commits.py
body:
Implements process_commits.py — reads data/commits.json and converts each commit into a human-readable text document ready for embedding.

Each document includes:
- id (short commit SHA)
- text (readable summary: author, date, message, files changed)
- metadata (full SHA, author, date, files_changed)
author: Mourad-Fikry
